# Power BI Dashboard — Step-by-Step Setup Guide
## NET Service Data Quality & ENETS Readiness Dashboard

**Author:** Sherin David Layanal  
**Tool required:** Power BI Desktop (free — download from microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/desktop)  
**Input:** `outputs/powerbi_master.xlsx` (generated by scripts 01–03)

---

## Before you start

1. Download and install **Power BI Desktop** (free, Windows only)
2. Run all three Python scripts first to generate `powerbi_master.xlsx`
3. Open Power BI Desktop → click **Get Data** → **Excel Workbook** → select `outputs/powerbi_master.xlsx`
4. In the Navigator, tick **all 11 sheets** → click **Transform Data**

---

## Step 1 — Clean data in Power Query

In the Power Query Editor:

### Patient Data sheet
- Select `diagnosis_date`, `treatment_start_date`, `last_followup_date` columns
- Change Type → **Date**
- Select `followup_gap_days`, `age_at_diagnosis`, `ki67_percent` → Change Type → **Decimal Number**
- Click **Close & Apply**

### Create a relationship
- Go to **Model view** (left sidebar, middle icon)
- Drag `Patient Data[patient_id]` → `ENETS Readiness[patient_id]`
- Drag `Patient Data[patient_id]` → `Query Report[patient_id]`
- Set all relationships to **Many-to-One**, **Single** direction

---

## Step 2 — Create calculated measures (DAX)

Click **New Measure** in the Home ribbon. Add each of these:

```dax
-- Total patients
Total Patients = COUNTROWS('Patient Data')

-- ENETS submission readiness %
ENETS Ready % = 
DIVIDE(
    COUNTROWS(FILTER('ENETS Readiness', 'ENETS Readiness'[enets_submission_status] = "Ready")),
    COUNTROWS('ENETS Readiness'),
    0
) * 100

-- MDT discussion rate %
MDT Rate % = 
DIVIDE(
    COUNTROWS(FILTER('Patient Data', 'Patient Data'[mdt_discussed] = "Yes")),
    COUNTROWS('Patient Data'),
    0
) * 100

-- Open high severity queries
High Severity Queries = 
COUNTROWS(FILTER('Query Report', 'Query Report'[severity] = "High" && 'Query Report'[status] = "Open"))

-- Overdue follow-up count
Overdue Follow-up = 
COUNTROWS(FILTER('Patient Data', 'Patient Data'[followup_gap_days] > 365))

-- Stage IV percentage
Stage IV % = 
DIVIDE(
    COUNTROWS(FILTER('Patient Data', 'Patient Data'[stage] = "IV")),
    COUNTROWS('Patient Data'),
    0
) * 100
```

---

## Step 3 — Page 1: Service Overview

**Rename page:** Double-click tab → type `Service Overview`

**Set background colour:**  
Format → Canvas background → Colour: `#F5F7FA`

### KPI Cards (top row)
Add 4 × **Card** visuals across the top:
- Card 1: Field = `Total Patients` | Label: `Active Patients`
- Card 2: Field = `ENETS Ready %` | Label: `ENETS Submission Ready` | Format: 1 decimal
- Card 3: Field = `MDT Rate %` | Label: `MDT Discussion Rate` | Format: 1 decimal  
- Card 4: Field = `High Severity Queries` | Label: `Open High Queries`

**Format all cards:**
- Background: `#003087` (Cardiff navy)
- Font colour: `#FFFFFF`
- Call-out value colour: `#C8A951` (Cardiff gold)
- Border radius: 4px

### Chart 1: Tumour Site Distribution (Donut)
- Visual: **Donut chart**
- Legend: `tumour_site`
- Values: `Count of patient_id`
- Title: `Patients by Tumour Site`
- Colours: use blues/teals from the Cardiff palette

### Chart 2: Grade Breakdown (Bar)
- Visual: **Clustered bar chart**
- Y-axis: `tumour_grade`
- X-axis: `Count of patient_id`
- Title: `Tumour Grade (G1 / G2 / G3)`
- Colours: G1 = `#1A6B3C` (green), G2 = `#C8A951` (gold), G3 = `#8B1A1A` (red)

### Chart 3: Treatment Modality (Horizontal bar)
- Visual: **Clustered bar chart**
- Y-axis: `primary_treatment`
- X-axis: `Count of patient_id`
- Sort: Descending by count
- Title: `Treatment Modality Distribution`
- Bar colour: `#003087`

### Chart 4: Patients by Referring Health Board
- Visual: **Clustered column chart**
- X-axis: `referring_health_board`
- Y-axis: `Count of patient_id`
- Title: `Referrals by Health Board`
- Bar colour: `#C8A951`

### Chart 5: Monthly Registrations (Line)
- Visual: **Line chart**
- X-axis: `year_month` (from Monthly Registrations sheet)
- Y-axis: `new_registrations`
- Secondary Y: `cumulative_patients`
- Title: `New Patient Registrations Over Time`
- Line colour: `#003087`

---

## Step 4 — Page 2: ENETS Compliance Tracker

**Add new page → rename:** `ENETS Compliance`

### Gauge chart — overall readiness
- Visual: **Gauge**
- Value: `ENETS Ready %`
- Min: 0 | Max: 100 | Target: 90
- Title: `ENETS Submission Readiness`
- Colour below target: `#8B1A1A` | At/above target: `#1A6B3C`

### Field completeness (Horizontal bar)
- Data source: `ENETS Field Completeness` sheet
- Visual: **Clustered bar chart**
- Y-axis: `enets_field`
- X-axis: `completeness_pct`
- Add constant line at X = 90 (target threshold)
- Title: `ENETS Field Completeness by Data Item`
- Conditional formatting: Red if <80%, Amber 80–89%, Green ≥90%

### ENETS readiness status table
- Visual: **Table**
- Columns: `patient_id`, `tumour_site`, `tumour_grade`, `stage`, `enets_submission_status`
- Conditional formatting on `enets_submission_status`:
  - Ready = Green background
  - Not Ready = Red background
  - Review Required = Amber background
- Add **Slicer**: `enets_submission_status` (allow multi-select)
- Title: `Patient Submission Status`

### Completeness over time (trend line)
- Visual: **Area chart**
- X-axis: `diagnosis_date` (year level)
- Y-axis: average of `enets_fields_complete` (Yes = 1, No = 0)
- Title: `ENETS Data Completeness Trend by Diagnosis Year`

---

## Step 5 — Page 3: Data Quality Queries

**Add new page → rename:** `Data Quality`

### Query severity breakdown (Stacked bar)
- Visual: **Stacked bar chart**
- Y-axis: `rule_name` (from Query Report)
- X-axis: `Count of patient_id`
- Legend: `severity`
- Colours: High = `#8B1A1A`, Medium = `#C8A951`, Low = `#1A6B3C`
- Title: `Open Queries by Rule and Severity`

### Query volume KPI cards
Add 3 × Card visuals:
- Card 1: `High Severity Queries`
- Card 2: `Overdue Follow-up`
- Card 3: Total queries = `COUNTROWS('Query Report')`

### Open query table
- Visual: **Table**
- Columns: `patient_id`, `rule_name`, `field`, `observed_value`, `severity`, `recommendation`
- Sort: Severity descending (High first)
- Conditional formatting: High rows = light red background `#FDECEA`
- Add slicer: `severity` (single select)
- Title: `Open Query Log — Action Required`

### Query type pie chart
- Visual: **Pie chart**
- Legend: `rule_name`
- Values: `Count of patient_id`
- Title: `Query Distribution by Type`

## Step 7 — Export for interview

1. **File → Export → Export to PDF** → save as `NET_Dashboard_Portfolio.pdf`
2. **File → Save As** → save `.pbix` file (this is your GitHub portfolio file)
3. Take screenshots of each page for your README

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Dates not recognised | In Power Query: Change Type → Date |
| Relationship warning | Check both columns are same data type (Text) |
| Gauge not showing target line | Set Target value in Format → Gauge axis |
| Conditional formatting not applying | Use Field value rules, not gradient |
| Slicers not filtering table | Check relationship is active in Model view |
